groups.prompt:
Create a square educational illustration contact sheet. EXACTLY 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 equal square cells, arranged as a precise regular grid across the entire canvas. Each cell is a separate picture. Thin white dividers at exactly 25%, 50%, 75% horizontally and vertically. Soft warm watercolor children's picture-book illustrations, clear simple silhouettes, gentle colors, cream-white background in every cell. Keep every subject completely inside its cell, centered with generous empty margins; no overlap across cells; no cropped subjects. No letters, numbers, titles, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. Small contextual backgrounds only where requested. Render each scene exactly, in this left-to-right then top-to-bottom order:
Row 1, column 1: A white domestic duck with orange bill and feet swimming on a tiny blue pond.
Row 1, column 2: A large clear black ant, with six legs and two antennae, walking on soil.
Row 1, column 3: A squid swimming underwater, long pale tapered mantle, two triangular fins and a cluster of ten arms including two longer tentacles.
Row 1, column 4: Two ripe red strawberries with green leafy tops and tiny yellow seeds.
Row 2, column 1: Purple figs, one whole and one cut in half revealing pink seeded flesh.
Row 2, column 2: A green caterpillar crawling on a leaf.
Row 2, column 3: A small green and yellow pet budgerigar perched on a branch.
Row 2, column 4: A Japanese bush warbler, a small plain olive-brown songbird perched on a twig.
Row 3, column 1: A round black sea urchin with many long spines on the seabed.
Row 3, column 2: A brown tree branch with a few fresh green leaves.
Row 3, column 3: A cluster of enoki mushrooms with slender white stems and tiny white caps.
Row 3, column 4: A whole pink shrimp, long antennae, curved segmented body and small legs.
Row 4, column 1: A few dry round pale yellow soybeans beside an open green soybean pod.
Row 4, column 2: A green frog with large bent hind legs sitting at the edge of a pond.
Row 4, column 3: A Japanese rhinoceros beetle with a prominent forked horn, six legs, on a log.
Row 4, column 4: A green praying mantis with two folded sickle shaped front legs standing on a leaf.
